full_page.content:
1934, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 195 May Helen Maggie now 33 before Xmas in Hospital .... "Jesus can cure me at home", walking since Easter .... now coughs ...
Pauline Meyers - 48 - Psoriasis 10 yrs. Terrible itch & pain. Chester Walajtyn - 11 mo. Bn. blind - from Harber Beach. Mary Gerardi - 13 - on crutches since a baby. Bernadette Sn Sona - 67 - bad rupt. Phylis Baer - 10 mo. non cath., hurt at time of birth. ..
23 Mrs. Eliz Smith - Richmond ... nonC. - 66 - cancer dying 13 months ago, here To-day a.m. wants to be Cath ..... daughter fell last July ....
Wayward Husband -! ! !? ?? John McMullen - 78 - away from Church 35-40 Religious Community ..... harmony
27 Mary Riester - about 19 - lost pt. breast - had promised perpetual enrollment to the Poor Souls if groth disappeared without opera- tion. This she promised to do every month for year. After five such enrollments she decided to permit operation as best to do- seems beautifully resigned.
Page 196 May 28 Sam Bommarito - 34 To-day - absent from family and sister for 5 yrs. - no word - enrolled for 1 yr.50 Sylvester Hasenauer - 42 - leg & shoulder hurt - wife+
Leo Babcock - 35 - in Grace Hosp. - neck broken since last Wednes- day - mason.
30
Mary Lueck-Ep. & Father John Nopper - 16 - asthma since 2 .... Eliz Treese - 17 - appendicitis ... Mr. . McCarty Eileen Ward - 9 mo. given up by Drs. in Jan. now home but ... no apetite.
